title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Tuning templates in Agent Builder for agents tuned on organisational data
summary: Hold: limiting tuning does not block every new or in-flight tuning job; authorised users can continue tuning. The roadmap facts, preview licensing and agent-blocking controls are supported, but the briefing also needs to acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance about disabling tuning.

claims.claim: Copilot Tuning introduces Agent Builder templates whose context, tools and models enabled users can customise with organisational data.
claims.quote: Users with Copilot Tuning enabled can further customize the template-based agents by tuning the context, tools, and underlying models with their organization’s proprietary data, processes, and standards.
